description: An operations KPI console composed from the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5 with no grid dependency: SvStat tiles paired with SvSparkline area charts, an SvGauge SLA dial from 95 to 100 percent with warning bands, SvHoverCard drill-down previews on each service row with status badges, an SvMenubar toolbar for View, Range and Actions, and a promise toast on Refresh.

faq.question: How are the tiles built?
faq.answer: Each tile is an SvCard holding an SvStat with label, value, delta and trend, and an SvSparkline fed the last points as data with a colour per metric.

faq.question: How does the SLA gauge focus on the top of the range?
faq.answer: min={95} and max={100} narrow the arc to the interesting band, and bands colours 95 to 99 amber and 99 to 100 green so small changes are visible.

faq.question: What does a promise toast do?
faq.answer: toast.promise takes the refresh promise and shows loading, success or error messages as it settles, so the user sees the outcome without extra state.
